title: Pricing an Approved Change Request Against a Product's Own Charges
content:
The operations desk records change requests against a package, and what the latest of those it has approved asks for decides which of the product's charges the amendment charge's starting amount is read from. The latest change request approved against the package is the most recently submitted of the approved requests standing on it. These bases apply across Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products.

## The bases

**A member of the party to be replaced.** Where the latest change request approved against the package asks for a member of the party to be replaced, the starting amount is the product's name-change charge, read against every traveller the approved replacement requests standing on the package concern. The travellers so concerned are counted as the approved requests to replace a member of the party standing on that package: one such approved request concerns one traveller, 2 concern 2, and so on.

**The departure date to be moved.** Where the latest change request approved against the package asks for the departure date to be moved, the starting amount is the product's date-change charge, read against every traveller on the package.

**One component substituted for another.** Where the latest change request approved against the package asks for one component of the itinerary to be substituted for another, the starting amount is the product's component change charge, read once for the package, and not per traveller.

**Anything else.** Where the latest change request approved against the package asks for none of these three things, the starting amount is not read on any of the bases in this note.

## Which charge is read against what

| What the latest approved change request asks for | The product's charge read | Read against |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A member of the party replaced | name-change charge per traveller | every traveller the approved replacement requests concern |
| The departure date moved | date-change charge per traveller | every traveller on the package |
| One component substituted for another | component change charge | the package, once |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package recording 4 travellers, whose latest approved change request asks for the departure date to be moved, on a product whose date-change charge is 125.00 USD per traveller, has a starting amount of 500.00 USD. The same package, whose latest approved change request instead asks for one component to be substituted, on a product whose component change charge is 65.00 USD, has a starting amount of 65.00 USD however many travellers it records.

A package carrying 2 approved requests to replace a member of the party, the latest of them being the latest approved change request on the package, on a product whose name-change charge is 85.00 USD per traveller, has a starting amount of 170.00 USD.
